scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best State In Implementing The Maintenance And Welfare Of Parents And Senior Citizens Act, 2007, And Providing Services And Facilities To Senior Citizens
other_conditions: The nominee must be a State or Union Territory that has implemented the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007, including notifying the Act, framing rules, appointing maintenance officers, and constituting maintenance and appellate tribunals.
The State/UT must demonstrate a high level of settlement of maintenance claims and have a State Council for Senior Citizens that meets regularly.
The State/UT must have a comprehensive action plan for protecting the life and property of senior citizens and institutionalized medical support and geriatric healthcare infrastructure.
The State/UT must promote research on chronic, terminal, and degenerative diseases affecting the elderly and maintain a network of old‑age homes, service centres, helplines, or volunteer bureaus.
Nominations must be made in writing by an authorized agency; self‑nominations are not accepted.
The award is open to all Indian institutions, organisations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, memento, cash award and reimbursement of travel, lodging and per‑diem expenses for themselves and one companion.
